foundation.shared.title: One shared foundation

foundation.local.title: Your device comes first

foundation.open.title: Room to grow
foundation.open.description: Independent modules leave space for future diagram tools.
preferences.title: Make yourself at home
preferences.description: Choose how your studio looks and speaks.
storage.unavailable: Preferences cannot be saved on this device. Your choices apply for this session.
footer.milestone: Project storage milestone · Canvas coming later
project.asCopy: Import as a new project (new project ID)
project.name: Project name
project.canvasLater: Project storage is ready. Canvas editing comes in a later milestone.
project.recoverConfirm: Open the previous saved version? Your current saved version is retained as a backup when recovery is saved.
project.discard: Discard unsaved changes? Export a backup first if local saving failed.
project.backup: Changes save automatically after a short pause. Keep exported backups: clearing browser data or losing this device can remove local projects.
project.error.invalid: This project is invalid. Check its name, file contents, and references. Your existing saved data is unchanged.
project.error.unsupported: This project needs an unsupported format version or required feature. Open it with a compatible version of Koxora.
project.error.tooLarge: This project exceeds the supported file size or complexity limits.
project.error.storage: Local storage or file access failed. Keep this window open and export your project. Check free space and storage permissions before retrying.
project.error.conflict: This project already exists or was changed elsewhere. Export your changes, reopen the current version, or import as a new project. No existing data was overwritten.
project.error.missing: This project or previous save is not available.
project.error.integrity: The project failed its integrity check. Keep the original file and try a verified backup.
dashboard.title: Ideas start here.
dashboard.description: Your projects, together in one place. Ready for what comes next.
dashboard.localNote: Stored on this device. No account needed.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Make room for your next idea
dashboard.emptyDescription: Create your first project or import a .koxora file to get started.
confirmation.title: Before you continue
import.description: Open a portable .koxora project. Your documents and attached assets stay together.
export.overwriteMessage: A file already exists at this location. Replace it with this project?
export.cancelled: Export cancelled. No file was written.
export.downloaded: Project download started. Your local project remains saved separately.
workspace.canvasTitle: A space to shape your ideas
workspace.existingContent: This page contains project content, safely preserved. Canvas viewing and editing arrive in the next milestone.
workspace.canvasDescription: Your project is ready. Interactive canvas tools arrive in the next milestone. For now, organize your project and keep a portable backup.
workspace.autosaveDescription: Changes are saved on this device. Export a .koxora file for a portable backup.
project.recoveryAvailable: Try restoring the previous saved version.
canvas.emptyDescription: Choose a shape above and click to place it. Add labels, then connect your ideas.
canvas.hint: Space + drag to pan · Ctrl/Cmd + scroll to zoom · Alt bypasses snapping
canvas.helpBody: Shortcuts apply to the focused canvas unless a field or dialog is open. Text fields keep their native editing shortcuts. Use Tab to reach the tools and project actions.
canvas.snapHelp: Snap movement, resizing and insertion to the grid. Hold Alt to bypass; Shift preserves proportions while resizing.
canvas.preview: Supported shapes and connections are editable. Unsupported imported objects keep their original data and remain read-only.
canvas.limited: Dense view: preview limited to 1,500 visible nodes and 1,500 connections. Zoom in to see more detail. All elements remain in the project.
canvas.adjusted: This saved view exceeds navigation limits. A bounded view is displayed; the original view stays unchanged until you navigate.
canvas.future: This page uses newer view settings. Navigation is temporary; its saved view and settings remain unchanged.
diagram.panHelp: Drag to pan. Space-drag also pans from any tool.
diagram.insertHelp: Click to place or drag to draw. Enter places at the view center. Escape cancels. Alt bypasses snapping; Shift keeps proportions.
diagram.connectHelp: Choose a source, then a target shape.
diagram.editHelp: Click a shape or connection, or choose an element below to edit.
diagram.sourceHelp: Choose the source shape on the canvas or from the element list.
diagram.targetHelp: Source selected. Choose a target port or shape. Escape cancels.
diagram.label: Label / text
diagram.error.endpoint: Choose two different editable shapes on this page.
diagram.error.unsupported: This element contains unsupported content. It is preserved without changes.
diagram.error.invalid: The change could not be applied. Check the values; your diagram is unchanged.
editing.selectHelp: Click to select; Shift adds or removes. Drag to move or draw a selection. Double-click or Enter edits. Space-drag pans.
editing.undoHelp: Undo (Ctrl/Cmd+Z). History stays in this session.
editing.copied: Copied to this canvas clipboard. Ordinary clipboard text is unchanged.
editing.noHistory: No history available for this page.
editing.renameHelp: Double-click to rename. Enter or leaving the field saves; Escape cancels.
editing.invalidName: Enter a name with 1–1024 characters and no control characters.
editing.renameFailed: The name could not be saved. Review the error message and try again.
diagram.toolHelp: Click or drag on the canvas. Escape returns to Select.
diagram.linkHelp: Choose ports or two shapes to connect; drag on empty canvas for a free line.
ports.heading: Connection ports
ports.label: {name}: {anchor} connection point
text.heading: Text and formatting
text.scope: Formatting applies to the whole label. Enter creates a new line. Fonts use local system fallbacks.
shortcuts.keys.pan: Space + drag / middle drag / two fingers
shortcuts.keys.select: Click / Shift + click / drag blank canvas
shortcuts.keys.link: Click source, then target / drag between shapes
shortcuts.pan: Pan with Space + drag, middle mouse, Pan tool or two-finger drag.
shortcuts.wheel: Pan vertically; hold Shift to pan horizontally.
shortcuts.zoomWheel: Zoom around the pointer or pinch center.
shortcuts.panKeys: Pan when no shapes are selected; Shift increases the distance.
shortcuts.zoom: Zoom in or out on the focused canvas.
shortcuts.select: With Select: choose one, toggle selection, or draw a selection rectangle.
shortcuts.focus: Move focus between controls; dialogs keep focus inside.
shortcuts.palette: Navigate tools or connection ports. Home/End goes to the first/last.
shortcuts.activate: Activate the focused tool, connection port or button.
shortcuts.place: Choose a shape, then click to place or drag to set its size. Blank-canvas Line/Arrow gestures create free-standing elements.
shortcuts.insertCenter: With an insertion tool and canvas focus, insert at the viewport center.
shortcuts.link: Line/Arrow connects two shapes. Ports choose top/right/bottom/left; shape bodies use automatic anchors. Connect by name provides the same choices without pointing. Connections follow move/resize.
shortcuts.cancel: Cancel a gesture or pending connection, clear selection and return to Select. Press again to leave expanded view.
shortcuts.moveResize: Move selected shapes or resize a single shape. Line endpoint handles change free-standing lines.
shortcuts.nudge: With Select and selected shapes: move one grid step, or one unit when snapping is off.
shortcuts.aspect: Keep the aspect ratio while resizing; draw a square when inserting shapes.
shortcuts.properties: Open text formatting and element properties. Also available through Align & more → Diagram element.
shortcuts.newline: In a label field: insert a new line.
shortcuts.apply: Apply the properties dialog as one undoable edit.
shortcuts.closeProperties: Close the dialog without applying changes.
shortcuts.textNative: In text fields: native select, copy, paste, cut and undo; document shortcuts are suspended.
shortcuts.undo: Undo the last document edit in this session.
shortcuts.copy: Copy editable selection to the in-app clipboard.
shortcuts.paste: Paste the in-app clipboard with new identities.
shortcuts.projectActions: Focus and activate New, Open, Save, Import, Export and recovery controls. These have no dedicated key binding.
shortcuts.openHelp: Open this searchable reference while focus is in the canvas workspace.
diagram.selectHelp: Click or drag to select. Double-click or Enter edits; Escape clears selection.
tabs.name: Name
tabs.deleteWarning: Delete this page and its contents? You can restore it with Undo. Pages with incoming links or semantic references are protected.
tabs.error.lastPage: Keep at least one page in each document. Create another page before moving or deleting this one.
tabs.error.references: This operation would invalidate semantic references. The project is unchanged. Review linked actions, relationships and domain models first.
tabs.error.invalid: Enter a valid name or page position.
rich.help: Select text to format words. Ctrl/Cmd+B, I, U · Enter for a new paragraph · Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to apply · Escape to cancel. Fonts use offline local fallbacks.
rich.limit: The edit exceeds the supported text limit (4,096 characters). It was not applied.
rich.pasteNote: Pasted text keeps supported formatting. Images, links and unsupported formatting are omitted.
format.heading: Format selection
format.help: Only properties you change are applied. Mixed values and other text formatting are preserved. Fill and corners apply only to shapes.
format.error: Formatting could not be applied. No elements were changed.
tabs.error.historyLimit: This change exceeds the undo memory limit. Nothing was changed. Export a backup and reduce the page size first.
shortcuts.tabs: Navigate the project tree with arrows. Enter opens a page; F2 renames; Alt+Up/Down reorders.
shortcuts.moveTab: Reorder the focused page or document. The context menu also provides touch and cross-document movement.
shortcuts.renameTab: Rename a page or open its action menu. Enter confirms; Escape cancels.
shortcuts.formatText: Bold, italic or underline selected text. Font, size and color apply to the selection or subsequent typing.
freehand.help: Draw with mouse, touch or pen. Keyboard: Enter starts/finishes a stroke, arrows draw, Shift uses larger steps, Escape cancels.
freehand.limit: This stroke is too long. Nothing was added. Continue with a new, shorter stroke.
stack.heading: Stacking
stack.help: Changes stacking within each layer. Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Up/Down; add Shift for front/back.
arrange.alignHelp: Align changes one axis and can place objects on top of each other. Hover or focus a command to preview; click to apply. Undo restores the selection in one step.
arrange.distributeHelp: Equal gaps between the outer objects (at least three). Existing overlaps may remain.
arrange.tidyHelp: Places selected editable objects in a grid with gaps, avoiding other visible objects. Unselected objects stay in place.
editing.preview: Arrangement preview — click to apply, Escape to cancel.
text.editContrast: Editing backdrops keep each text color visible; they are not saved. Dashed underlines reveal transparent text while editing.
tree.heading: Project navigator
tree.deleteProjectWarning: Move this local project to Trash? Its content and recovery snapshots are kept and can be restored. Exported files are not changed.
tree.deleteDocumentWarning: Delete this document and all its pages? Undo restores it. Referenced content is protected.
tree.sameProject: Moves this page to a document in the same project. Moving pages between separate projects is not available.
tabs.error.lastDocument: Keep at least one document in the project.
shortcuts.stack: Move selection one step forward/backward in its layer; add Shift for front/back.
shortcuts.pen: Draw with mouse, touch or pen. Keyboard: Enter starts/finishes a stroke, arrows draw, Shift uses larger steps, Escape cancels.
